lines.text: I died twelve hundred times. Why is there a ladder *up?*
lines.style: Young man, fast and breathless, no pauses, the question shot out sharp and urgent.

lines.text: Below me, the doors shut on the new *me.*
lines.style: Young man, hushed, guilty, quick, the last word heavy.

lines.text: Up here, two hundred cables. Every one had my *name.*
lines.style: Young man, whisper, awed and horrified, slow on the last word.
Young man, sharp and fast, a gasp on the last word.

lines.text: Somewhere below, a Theo was falling. Just like *I* did.
lines.style: Young man, shaking whisper, realisation, rising dread.

lines.text: And someone was walking down the rows, cutting them one by *one.*
lines.style: Young man, very quiet, terrified, slow and tense, each word careful.
Young man, shocked, a clear tense whisper, every word distinct.

lines.text: She held up the key. And pointed at *my* cable.
lines.style: Young man, fast panicked whisper, the stress on my.

lines.text: Take the key... or grab the *shears?*
lines.style: Young man, panicking, fast and desperate, torn between two choices.

lines.text: Comment *A* or *B.* You decide what I do.
lines.style: Young man, urgent and direct, speaking straight to the viewer, pleading but steady.

music.title: Floor 0 - The Cables
music.style: Horror thriller score. Starts instantly on a sharp stinger and fast climbing footsteps on metal, a vast dark attic drone, hundreds of steel cables creaking and humming, a cable snapping like a gunshot into a deep sub boom, a long falling whoosh, slow metallic scissor snips coming closer, a cold detuned music box for a little girl, then racing heartbeat and ticking to a sudden cut. Instrumental only, no vocals, mixed to sit under a voiceover.
